args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` was rounding to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- Changed the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Per FIN-212, rounding must be banker's rounding to the cent.
args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
